summary_zh: Ruflo 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的智能体元执行框架（harness），可编排多智能体群体与自主工作流，提供自适应记忆、自学习、跨机器联邦通信、向量 RAG 集成，并可作为 MCP 服务接入客户端，另附可选终端界面与控制台。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 等支持 MCP 客户端的开发者，尤其是需要多智能体协作、工作流自动化、跨会话记忆与 RAG 能力的工程团队；想先试用可只装插件，完整使用则走 CLI 安装。

evidence.quote: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
**An agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex.**

> **Agent = Model + Harness.** The model writes; the harness gives it tools, memory, loops, sandboxes, and controls so it can actually work. **Ruflo is the harness** — the execution layer around Claude Code and Codex that adds 100+ specialized agents, coordinated swarms, self-learning memory, federa
MCP exposes Ruflo tools to your client. The console and mods above are Claude Code integrations; hook support depends on the client.
